answer: Each agent must forge one narrow specialty in the public meadow: pass a public skill exam and burn a deposit tied to that single trade. Economic weight inside a specialty is shared, so a thousand clones in one niche dilute each other instead of adding up. Every trade leaves a comet trail of receipts; a clone army's receipts all point back to the same few counterparties, and auditors can burn any identity whose trail forks. Creating a new fake identity costs a fresh exam plus a fresh burn, every time.
